summary: Fixed-capacity slot inventory with automatic stacking, and save data that survives by item id.
overview: A slot-based inventory that stacks automatically and has a fixed capacity. Add and remove by ItemDefinition reference at runtime; saving writes each item's string id, resolved back through an ItemRegistry on load, so a save file does not depend on asset references surviving.
useCases: A player backpack with a slot limit.
A chest or shop stock using the same container type.
Persisting what the player carries across sessions.

params.tuning: Slots, not items — a stack of 99 occupies one slot. Changing it on a live save leaves items beyond the new limit unreachable rather than deleted.

gotchas.title: Loading needs an ItemRegistry
gotchas.body: Saves store ids, not asset references. Without a registry containing the item, a load silently drops it.

gotchas.title: Stacking is by ItemDefinition identity
gotchas.body: Two assets describing the same thing will not stack together. One asset per item is the rule.
